presets.name: flat
presets.summary: One network. Every module, the BMC and both uplinks share it, and the switch does not look at VLANs at all. This is how a board ships.

presets.name: split
presets.summary: Two networks that never meet: the BMC out of ge0, the modules out of ge1. Nothing is tagged, so the other end needs no VLAN configuration at all.

presets.name: trunk
presets.summary: One cable carrying both networks, tagged, for a router that knows the VLANs. The identifiers are yours, because the router has to match them.
